function closeM(){$("modal").classList.remove("on")}
function summary(){const k=OD.k,f=FIELDS[k]||FIELDS.mem,sp=k=='special';const vals=[];let bad=false;
f.forEach(([l,ty,opt],j)=>{const v=$("f"+j).value.trim();if(!v&&!opt)bad=true;vals.push([l.split(" (")[0],v])});
let pm="",trx="";if(!sp){pm=$("pm").value;trx=$("trx").value.trim();if(!pm||!trx)bad=true}
if(bad){$("err").textContent=sp?"সব তথ্য পূরণ করুন।":"সব তথ্য, Payment Method ও TrxID দিন।";return}
let total=OD.p;if(k=='smm'){const q=parseFloat(vals[2][1]);if(!q||q<=0){$("err").textContent="সঠিক Quantity দিন।";return}total=Math.round(OD.p*q*100)/100}
const msg=["NMS Tech New Order",...vals.map(([l,v])=>l+": "+(v||"-")),"Service/Product: "+OD.n,...(OD.c?["Category: "+OD.c]:[]),...(sp?[]:["Payment Method: "+pm,"TrxID: "+trx]),"Total Price: ৳"+total].join("\n");
const link="https://wa.me/"+WA+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(msg);
$("box").innerHTML=`<h3>Order Summary</h3><div class="sum">${msg.split("\n").map(esc).join("<br>")}</div><div class="row"><button class="btn s" onclick="closeM()">Cancel</button><a class="btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="${link}" onclick="setTimeout(closeM,300)">${sp?"📲 Direct Deal on WhatsApp":"Confirm &amp; Submit"}</a></div>`}
render();
</script></body></html>
